protocol.status: frozen 2026-11-21 on Juan PC (4 vCPU / 6 GiB VM); Placement campaign matrix, both through Apache, 120 s client timeouts
protocol.scope: Glance Python versus Glance Go, same 9 loads as v4 with the Placement campaign matrix (C=1/4/8/16, 5 repetitions); both implementations measured through Apache /image; Python notifications noop, Go messagingv2 (as v4)
protocol.predecessor: glance-compact-v4 accepted 108/108 (Juan PC); v4 measured Python through Apache and Go directly on its port
protocol.acceptance: All 108 windows valid for this reduced scope; hashes, lengths, state, resource sampling, cleanup and original restoration verified; no minimum speedup required
protocol.purpose: Fair route (both behind Apache, as Nova reaches Glance) and the Placement campaign matrix; current Glance Go (single-query catalog reads, download streams = GOMAXPROCS)

protocol.statistics: Five independent paired repetitions per cell; publish individual results, median and range; bootstrap confidence only as declared
protocol.reason: v3 keeps Python noop because stock messagingv2 with CacheFilter exhausted LimitNOFILE in v2. v4 keeps that and additionally enables Go notifications, so Go does strictly more work than Python. Not comparable in absolute values with v3 (different hardware).
protocol.timeout_reason: Pilot attempts 1 and 3 stopped at upload-64m C=16: a small metadata GET of the original waited 10.05 s behind 64 MiB uploads (2 uWSGI workers saturated, ~78 MiB/s for 16 clients) and hit the client 10 s timeout. 120 s, as for binary requests, records that wait as latency; requests over 10 s are counted per window (requests_over_10s). Any HTTP error, wrong bytes or failed cleanup still invalidates the window.
